title: In Range
statement: Implement `solve(value, low, high)`. Return 1 when `low <= value <= high`, and 0 otherwise. The range is inclusive. Use one chained comparison.
hints: Write low <= value <= high. Python chains it.
The endpoints belong inside the range.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A chained comparison is two comparisons and a conjunction, evaluated without storing a temporary boolean you then forget to combine.

editorial: A chained comparison is two comparisons and a conjunction, evaluated without storing a temporary boolean you then forget to combine. Inclusive ends are the usual contract for scores and indexes that name a closed interval.
